correctness.rationale: PASS: Read the actual six minimal presentations in Robles-Perez/Rosales Proposition 33 and checked the generator ordering matches. Every presentation move has distance bounded by its largest side length, giving the six matching upper bounds. For classes 1,2,4 mod 6 the pure (n+3)e1 factorization is disjoint from any other factorization by uniqueness of (n+2)e1; the known ne2 alternative forces a step >=n+3. For classes 3,5, pure (n+2)e4 is disjoint and any other factorization uses generators <=g3, hence has at least n+5 atoms. For class 0, complete presentation moves from (n+4)e2 cannot create simultaneous e2/e3 needed for the e4 relation, so the fiber has no e4; pure (n+1)e3 is isolated and every other uses g1,g2 and length >=n+4. All coefficients were verified nonnegative integers. Independently checked equality of all relation weights and maximum side lengths for n=4..33 and exact bottleneck catenary degree in all critical Betti fibers for representative n=4..9. These finite tests are supplementary to the all-n presentation/completeness argument.
